title_translated: 大语言模型智能体多轮一致性的评估：生存分析与失败原因分类体系
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLM）代理可能在孤立任务上表现良好，但在长时间交互中出现不一致。我们在受控的20步多智能体环境中评估时间一致性，该环境受延迟满足研究启发。每一步，代理需在继续延迟奖励与立即领取奖励（终止回合）之间做出选择。通过对社会可见性（私密 vs. 公开）、人格压力因素和 deliberation 策略进行全因子操控，我们运行了跨越8个模型家族的84,540条轨迹。将首次领取奖励视为时间至事件结果，我们估计Kaplan-Meier生存曲线并拟合离散时间风险回归模型，量化实验因素如何随时间改变失败风险。随后，为分析失败相关的推理逻辑与语言模式，我们从13,780条选择终止回合的代理推理轨迹中构建了一个七类分类体系，采用LLM辅助标注结合人工审计（κ=0.83）。推理模式随时间和情境系统性变化：早期失败更受冲动驱动，后期失败更多体现疲劳与成本效益权衡，而在公开环境中则增加规范导向的辩护。我们还发现推理不一致关联：在失败案例中，较长的推理文本与更高的内部矛盾率相关（同时存在支持延迟和主张领取的陈述），挑战了“更多推理=更高一致性”的假设。生存分析与推理分析共同揭示了不同时间可靠性阶段和模型特有的“失败指纹”，为诊断多轮智能体行为不一致提供了评估视角。

summary: Public software repositories, like GitHub and Software Heritage Archive, store billions of files, yet extracting their implicit engineering knowledge ---i.e., the algorithms they implement, the paradigms they follow, the patterns they instantiate, and the application domains they serve--- remains challenging, as current tools are constrained to syntactic and token-level analysis. We present a pipeline for building an open-taxonomy semantic annotation of source code using a code-specialised Large Language Model. The extracted entities are grounded in Wikidata through a three-stage linking procedure: a deterministic SPARQL stage handles unambiguous entities, a Deep Research Agent resolves the residual long tail, and a hierarchy-rollup stage imports the parent-of closure of each resolved Wikidata identifier. The resulting annotations are materialised as a source-code-specific open-taxonomy knowledge graph. We further introduce a calibrated quality-assurance protocol that quantifies annotation precision by combining a small human gold set with an LLM-as-a-judge filter. We applied our pipeline to the 167 million files of the Stack-Edu corpus, creating the first known large-scale open-taxonomy knowledge graph for source code. Our graph, named CodeGraph, contains approximately 158 million nodes, which include around 145 million files, about 63,000 extracted concept entities (such as algorithms, paradigms, design patterns, and application domains), and roughly 19,800 grounded Wikidata entities. Furthermore, CodeGraph features approximately 1 billion typed edges that connect files to their respective concepts, link these concepts to their grounded Wikidata identifiers, and relate them to their parent categories, covering 14 programming languages.
title: CodeGraph: Open-Taxonomy Knowledge Graph for Source Code with Wikidata Grounding
title_translated: CodeGraph：基于Wikidata锚定的开源源代码知识图谱
summary_translated: 公共软件仓库如GitHub和Software Heritage Archive存储了数十亿个文件，但提取其隐含工程知识——即所实现的算法、遵循的范式、实例化的模式以及服务的应用领域——仍具挑战性，因为当前工具受限于语法和词元级分析。我们提出一种利用代码专用大语言模型构建源代码开放分类语义注释的流水线。提取的实体通过三阶段链接程序与Wikidata锚定：确定性SPARQL阶段处理明确实体，深度研究代理解决剩余长尾问题，层级回滚阶段导入每个已解析Wikidata标识符的父类闭包。最终注释被构造成特定于源代码的开放分类知识图谱。我们进一步引入校准的质量保障协议，通过小规模人工黄金集与LLM作为裁判过滤器相结合，量化注释精度。我们将该流水线应用于Stack-Edu语料库的1.67亿个文件，创建了首个已知的大规模源代码开源分类知识图谱。我们的图谱名为CodeGraph，包含约1.58亿个节点，其中包括约1.45亿个文件、约6.3万个提取的概念实体（如算法、范式、设计模式和应用领域），以及约1.98万个锚定的Wikidata实体。此外，CodeGraph包含约10亿条类型边，连接文件与其概念、将这些概念链接至其锚定的Wikidata标识符，并关联其父类别，覆盖14种编程语言。

summary: Detectors of alignment failures screen deployed language models and score alignment benchmarks. Most are generative judges that spend a decoding pass on every criterion, and classifiers that read token probabilities, such as Llama Guard, still score one fixed label per call. Jev, a model trained with reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD), answers many typed questions about one input with calibrated probabilities in a single call. Whether it detects alignment failures has not been measured. We present RLCDAlignBench, which benchmarks Jev on ten alignment failures: sycophancy, jailbreaks, deception, prompt injection, hallucination, privacy violation, social bias, reward hacking, concealing uncertainty, and power seeking. It spans 44 benchmarks and five target models, labelled by each benchmark's scorer and, on two, by humans. Many of these failures are relational, defined against a reference, such as the user's belief or an injected instruction, that the response alone does not reveal. Our key idea is therefore to vary what Jev is asked separately from what it sees: the question's wording and answer type on one side, the fields of the input on the other. A single generic question reaches a median AUROC of 0.886 zero-shot and beats supervised baselines on most benchmarks. Question wording matters little, while context matters more, mostly through fields that encode the label. Jev matches the reference scorer's agreement with human labels, surfaces label defects in existing benchmarks, and costs 63x less than LLM-judge scorers. Code and data: https://github.com/sumleo/RLCDAlignBench.
title: Just Ask Jev: Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions as a Zero-Shot Detector of AI Alignment Failures
title_translated: Just Ask Jev：基于校准决策强化学习的零样本AI对齐失败检测器
summary_translated: 对齐失败检测器用于筛查部署的语言模型并评分对齐基准。大多数为生成式裁判，在每个标准上都需一次解码，而如Llama Guard等分类器仍对每次调用输出单一固定标签。Jev是一种通过强化学习进行校准决策（RLCD）训练的模型，可在单次调用中回答关于同一输入的多个类型问题，并给出校准概率。其是否能检测对齐失败尚未经过测量。我们提出RLCDAlignBench，该基准在十个对齐失败场景上测试Jev：阿谀奉承、越狱攻击、欺骗、提示注入、幻觉、隐私侵犯、社会偏见、奖励劫持、隐藏不确定性与权力追求。涵盖44个基准和五个目标模型，由各基准评分器标注，其中两个也由人工标注。这些失败中的许多具有关系性，需相对于参考对象（如用户信念或注入指令）定义，仅凭响应本身无法揭示。因此，我们的核心思想是将Jev被询问的内容与它所见的内容分开：一侧是问题表述与答案类型，另一侧是输入字段。一个通用问题即可实现0.886的零样本中位AUROC，且在多数基准上优于监督基线。问题表述影响较小，而上下文影响更大，主要通过编码标签的字段体现。Jev与参考评分器在人类标签上的共识一致，揭示了现有基准中的标签缺陷，且成本仅为LLM裁判评分器的1/63。代码与数据：https://github.com/sumleo/RLCDAlignBench。

summary: CAR-bench evaluates whether tool-using agents stay reliable under real-world uncertainty, executing every tool inside the evaluator so that each tool-result exchange is a separate agent round-trip. A conventional next-action agent can batch parallel tool calls, but a chain of dependent calls costs it one model call per round of results. We present a coroutine-bridge harness in which the model's only action is to emit a Python program that blocks and resumes in place across evaluator tool exchanges. This decouples model invocation from tool round-trips: on the public test split the agent uses a median of two model calls against seven agent turns per task, resolving a full multi-turn task in a median of 1.8 s of model latency on Cerebras gpt-oss-120b. Because the action surface is executable code, deterministic CAR-bench policies are encoded directly as logic in the tool layer rather than as prompt rules, enforcing compliance at zero reasoning cost. On the official hidden evaluation the harness won Track 2 with 60.0% Pass^3, 4.5x the organizer baseline, at the lowest estimated cost and the fastest median task latency (3.14 s) of any entry scoring above that baseline; the same unchanged harness reproduced an identical 60.0% Pass^3 on GPT-5.5 in the Open track, matching frontier-model agents. A single static prompt, appended with per-task state at the tail, stays byte-identical across calls and across tasks: the frozen submission prompt served 78% of input tokens from cache (86.6% across its warm tail), against 73% over a three-week development corpus in which prompt edits repeatedly reset the cache. This compounds the few-call design into a small fraction of nominal input compute.
title: Policy as Code: A Coroutine-Bridge Harness for Fast-Reasoning Reliability on CAR-bench
comment: 4 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Technical report for the winning entry in Track 2 (Cerebras Fast-Reasoning) of the CAR-bench Challenge at IJCAI-ECAI 2026
title_translated: 策略即代码：一种协程桥接框架，用于在CAR-bench上实现快速推理的可靠性
summary_translated: CAR-bench评估工具使用智能体在现实世界不确定性下是否保持可靠，每个工具的执行都在评估器内部完成，每次工具结果交换都构成一次独立的智能体往返。传统下一动作智能体可以批量并行调用工具，但依赖链式调用会使其每轮结果增加一次模型调用。我们提出一种协程桥接框架，其中模型唯一操作是生成一个Python程序，该程序可在评估器工具交换中阻塞并恢复执行。这将模型调用与工具往返解耦：在公开测试集上，该智能体每任务仅需平均2次模型调用，对应7次智能体回合，单个多轮任务的模型延迟中位数仅为1.8秒（在Cerebras gpt-oss-120b上）。由于动作表面为可执行代码，确定性的CAR-bench策略直接编码在工具层逻辑中，而非提示规则，从而以零推理成本强制合规。在官方隐藏评估中，该框架以60.0% Pass^3成绩赢得Track 2，是组织者基线的4.5倍，且成本最低、任务延迟中位数最快（3.14秒），所有高于基线的参赛者中表现最优；同一未修改框架在GPT-5.5上的开放赛道也复现了相同的60.0% Pass^3，与前沿模型智能体持平。一个静态提示词，仅在末尾附加每任务状态，跨调用和跨任务保持字节一致：冻结提交提示词从缓存中服务了78%的输入token（其热尾部分达86.6%），而三周开发语料中提示编辑反复重置缓存，仅达到73%。这一特性将少调用设计进一步压缩至名义输入计算量的极小比例。

summary: In cross-lingual zero-shot text-to-speech, the accent of the reference leaks into the target speech. We propose accent analogy guidance (AAG), a training-free sampler term that subtracts an accent direction estimated from the model's own predictions for one synthetic voice rendered in both languages, so the voice cancels and only the accent remains. By a blind LLM accent judge on real dubbing data, reweighting classifier-free guidance between reference and text, and its variants, stay near one identity-accent trade-off curve; we score a method by its speaker similarity above that curve at equal accent ($Δ$SIM). Across four open TTS models AAG lies above the curve: on OmniVoice $Δ$SIM is +0.11 to +0.27 on three test sets (accent 3.51 to 4.28 on a 1-5 scale at speaker similarity 0.29, where reweighting keeps 0.02); MaskGCT and CosyVoice 2 also lie above their curves, and on F5-TTS it is more native than any reweighting setting. An LLM-free language-ID measure and a twelve-listener panel agree. A premise test and the reach of a model's own curve indicate in advance whether and roughly how much AAG can gain, predicting the one model where it gains nothing (X-Voice).
title: Accent Analogy Guidance: More Speaker Similarity at Equal Accent in Cross-Lingual Voice Cloning
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Listening samples: this https URL
title_translated: 口音类比引导：跨语言语音克隆中相同口音下的更高说话人相似性
summary_translated: 在跨语言零样本文本到语音合成中，参考语音的口音会泄露到目标语音中。我们提出口音类比引导（AAG），一种无需训练的采样项，通过从模型自身对同一合成语音在两种语言中的预测中估计口音方向并减去，使语音相互抵消，仅保留口音。通过盲测LLM口音判断员对真实配音数据的评估，重新加权无分类器引导中参考语音与文本之间的权重及其变体，均接近于一条身份-口音权衡曲线；我们通过在相同口音下高于该曲线的说话人相似性（ΔSIM）来评分。在四个开源TTS模型中，AAG均位于该曲线之上：在OmniVoice上，ΔSIM提升0.11至0.27，在三个测试集上口音评分为3.51至4.28（1-5分制），说话人相似性为0.29，重新加权保持0.02；MaskGCT和CosyVoice 2也优于各自曲线，F5-TTS则比任何重新加权设置更自然。无LLM的语言识别度量和十二人听觉小组评估结果一致。前提测试及模型自身曲线的覆盖范围可提前预判AAG的增益潜力，成功预测出在X-Voice模型上无任何增益的情况。

summary: Cancer registrars, including Oncology Data Specialists (ODSs), must interpret complex and frequently updated coding and staging standards. We developed CRISS (Cancer Registry Intelligent Support System), a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) conversational assistant that provides rapid, citation-supported access to registry guidance. This study evaluated whether CRISS could (1) support accurate and citation-supported responses, (2) improve access to and interpretation of relevant guidance, and (3) support training/helpdesk use while preserving human oversight of final abstraction decisions. We built a domain-specific knowledge base from national cancer registry standards, segmented into metadata-tagged passages and indexed as dense embeddings. Retrieved passages were used to generate citation-grounded responses through a large language model (LLM). Open-weight, proprietary, and non-RAG baseline models across Gemini and GPT families were evaluated on easy, medium, and hard registry questions using an LLM-as-a-Judge protocols. RAG configurations consistently outperformed non-RAG approaches, especially as question difficulty increased. Mean grounding scores for RAG were 0.62/0.56/0.59 across easy/medium/hard tiers versus 0.29/0.26/0.29 for non-RAG. RAG models also achieved higher semantic-similarity scores overall. Proprietary RAG models performed strongest on easy and medium questions, while local RAG models ranked highest on hard questions and proprietary models were generally more cautious. Domain-specific RAG improved evidence grounding and response quality for cancer registry questions while enabling citation-supported assistance across complexity levels. CRISS demonstrates the potential of human-centered, citation-grounded AI to support cancer registrars while preserving human oversight for final coding decisions.
title: CRISS: A Retrieval-Augmented AI Chatbot for Assisting Cancer Registrars
comment: 21 pages, 13 figures, 7 tables. Keywords: cancer registry, retrieval-augmented generation, large language models, conversational AI, clinical informatics, oncology data specialists, medical question answering, AI safety, clinical decision support
title_translated: CRISS：一种用于辅助癌症登记员的检索增强型AI聊天机器人
summary_translated: 癌症登记员（包括肿瘤数据专家ODS）必须解读复杂且频繁更新的编码与分期标准。我们开发了CRISS（癌症登记智能支持系统），一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）的对话式助手，提供快速、带引用支持的注册指南访问。本研究评估CRISS是否能够（1）支持准确且有引用依据的回答，（2）改善对相关指南的获取与理解，（3）在保持人类对最终抽象决策监督的前提下支持培训与帮助台用途。我们从国家级癌症登记标准构建了一个领域特定知识库，将其分割为带元数据标签的段落，并以密集嵌入形式索引。检索到的段落通过大型语言模型（LLM）生成有引用依据的回答。我们使用LLM作为裁判协议，对Gemini和GPT系列中的开源、专有及非RAG基线模型在简单、中等和困难的登记问题上进行了评估。RAG配置在所有难度级别上均显著优于非RAG方法，尤其在难题上优势明显。RAG的平均置信度得分分别为0.62/0.56/0.59（简单/中等/困难），而非RAG仅为0.29/0.26/0.29。RAG模型整体语义相似度得分也更高。专有RAG模型在简单和中等问题上表现最强，而本地RAG模型在难题上排名最高，专有模型通常更为谨慎。领域特定的RAG提升了证据置信度和回答质量，同时在不同复杂度水平上实现了带引用支持的协助。CRISS展示了以人为本、基于引用的AI在支持癌症登记员方面的潜力，同时保留了人类对最终编码决策的监督。

summary: General Purpose Service Robot (GPSR) tasks, as defined in the RoboCup@Home benchmark, require robots to interpret diverse natural language commands and generate multi-step action sequences in real home environments. Conventional Single Prompt (SP) approaches suffer from context bloat and the "Lost in the Middle" phenomenon, leading to unreliable task planning. We propose an LLM chaining architecture that separates instruction classification and action generation into two specialized stages, reducing per-inference prompt length by approximately 45% while improving planning consistency. We evaluate our method using 100 randomly generated GPSR commands across three language models spanning local open-source and frontier cloud deployment contexts. Results show consistent planning improvements over SP across all models, with gains of up to +37 percentage points on local models. Further, real-robot execution experiments on the Toyota Human Support Robot (HSR) reveal that planning success alone does not guarantee task completion, with 6 of 10 tasks completing successfully and execution-layer failures identified as the primary remaining bottleneck.
title: Design and Evaluation of LLM Chaining-Based Task Planning for General Purpose Service Robots
comment: Accepted to IEEE GCCE 2026. 5 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables
title_translated: 基于LLM链式结构的任务规划设计与评估：通用服务机器人应用
summary_translated: 如RoboCup@Home基准所定义，通用服务机器人（GPSR）任务要求机器人在真实家庭环境中解释多样化的自然语言指令，并生成多步动作序列。传统的单提示（SP）方法存在上下文膨胀和“中间迷失”现象，导致任务规划不可靠。我们提出一种基于LLM链式的架构，将指令分类与动作生成分离为两个专门阶段，使每次推理的提示长度减少约45%，同时提高规划一致性。我们在三种语言模型（涵盖本地开源与前沿云端部署环境）上对100个随机生成的GPSR指令进行了评估。结果显示，所有模型在规划性能上均优于SP方法，本地模型提升幅度最高达+37个百分点。此外，对丰田人类支持机器人（HSR）的真实机器人执行实验表明，规划成功并不保证任务完成，10个任务中有6个成功，执行层失败被识别为主要剩余瓶颈。

summary: Decentralized LLM-based multi-agent systems coordinate through local interactions, but an agent can remain responsive while its task-solving quality persistently degrades. Such gray failures require protecting current tasks before sufficient evidence exists to alter future routing, while still allowing recovered agents to rejoin. We introduce MeshHeal, a fully decentralized self-healing framework that couples ability-matched peer review across two timescales. At the fast timescale, an adaptive hierarchy escalates uncertain or low-scoring outputs from repeated single-reviewer evaluation to committee deliberation and, when needed, correction before use. At the slow timescale, a task- and ability-conditioned peer-relative detector aggregates scores to distinguish persistent degradation from ordinary output variation, trigger mandatory committee review, and eventually exclude degraded agents from ordinary routing; recovery probes provide fresh evidence for reintegration. To faithfully evaluate routing, we introduce Model-Backed MAS Evaluation, which ties ability assignments to execution models, since prompt-based ability assignments alone can leave routing errors hidden. Across BBH, MATH, and MMLU-Pro, MeshHeal achieves 0.839 degraded-phase accuracy using 51k total model tokens per task, versus the strongest baseline Symphony's 0.807 accuracy using 115k per task. Under staggered degradation and recovery, MeshHeal isolates degraded agents, keeps them excluded from ordinary task execution until recovery, and returns them to normal routing.
title: MeshHeal: Two-Timescale Self-Healing for Gray Failures in Decentralized LLM Agent Networks
title_translated: MeshHeal：去中心化LLM智能体网络中灰故障的双时间尺度自愈机制
summary_translated: 去中心化的基于LLM的多智能体系统通过局部交互进行协调，但一个智能体可能仍保持响应性，而其任务求解质量却持续下降。此类灰故障需要在足够证据出现前保护当前任务，同时允许恢复后的智能体重新加入。我们引入MeshHeal，一种完全去中心化的自愈框架，通过两个时间尺度耦合能力匹配的同行评审。在快速时间尺度上，自适应层级将重复单评审中不确定或低分输出升级为委员会审议，必要时进行纠正后再使用。在慢速时间尺度上，基于任务和能力条件的同行相对检测器聚合评分，区分持久退化与正常输出波动，触发强制委员会审查，并最终将退化智能体排除在常规路由之外；恢复探测提供新证据以支持重新整合。为真实评估路由效果，我们提出“模型支撑的MAS评估”，将能力分配与执行模型绑定，因为仅基于提示的能力分配可能隐藏路由错误。在BBH、MATH和MMLU-Pro上，MeshHeal在退化阶段实现0.839的准确率，每任务仅使用51k总模型token，优于最强基线Symphony的0.807准确率（每任务115k token）。在交错退化与恢复条件下，MeshHeal能隔离退化智能体，将其排除在常规任务执行之外直至恢复，并最终将其恢复正常路由。

summary: We present a personalized Korean visual speech recognition (VSR) system and quantify, on the nine-camera OLKAVS corpus, the gap between the population-level benchmark score and an individual user's error. A video-only Conformer initialized from English-trained weights attains 9.95 - 12.19% character error rate (CER) under the corpus protocol against the published 26.64, and 19.00 - 21.52 on unseen wording. Per speaker, CER spans 1.0 to 52.2%, with seen wording lowering CER by 7.0 - 9.0 points and professional delivery and spontaneous speech raising it by 8.5 - 10.5 and 12.7 points. A low-rank adapter with 4.6% of the parameters, trained on 4 to 29 minutes of the user's frontal video, lowers the CER of twelve high-error speakers by 2.13 to 3.58 points, transfers to every camera without loss, and keeps 85% of the full fine-tuning gain at 12% of its cost to other speakers. Cameras above the mouth plane add about six CER points as a constant offset that training on all views keeps small.
title: Personalized Korean Lipreading as Visual Speech Recognition: Transfer, Census and Adaptation on OLKAVS
comment: Submitted to ICASSP 2027. 4 pages plus references
title_translated: 个性化韩语唇读作为视觉语音识别：在OLKAVS上的迁移、普查与适应
summary_translated: 我们提出了一种个性化的韩语视觉语音识别（VSR）系统，并在九摄像头的OLKAVS语料库上量化了群体级基准得分与单个用户错误之间的差距。一个仅基于视频的Conformer模型，初始化自英语训练权重，在语料库协议下达到9.95%至12.19%的字符错误率（CER），优于已发布的26.64和19.00%至21.52%的未见词汇表现。按说话人统计，CER范围为1.0%至52.2%，已见词汇使CER降低7.0至9.0个百分点，而专业表达和即兴口语则分别使其上升8.5至10.5和12.7个百分点。一个参数量仅为4.6%的低秩适配器，在4至29分钟的用户正面视频上训练后，将十二位高错误率说话人的CER降低了2.13至3.58个百分点，无需损失即可迁移到所有摄像头，并在12%的成本下保留85%的全微调收益。高于嘴部平面的摄像头会带来约六个CER点的恒定偏移，但通过多视角训练可将其保持在较低水平。

summary: New words are invented every day. A human listener can learn a new word by hearing it clearly once and inferring its usage from sentence context. This paper proposes granting ASR a similar ability to learn the contextual representations and spellings of new words from unlabeled test data at test time. A frozen CTC acoustic model provides spellings, a frozen language model provides contextual evidence for out-of-vocabulary (OOV) word detection, and an adaptation module expands the vocabulary by learning the lexical token representations with distributions over CTC-generated candidates. The spelling model of each token is optimized by minimizing a Kullback-Leibler divergence (KLD) objective. We demonstrate that the CTC-weighted language model log likelihood ratio can be interpreted as the KLD between the unknown correct ASR and the unsupervised learned ASR, and that, using a Pinsker bound, the square root of KLD can be interpreted as an upper bound on the total variation distance between the true and estimated spelling of the unknown word. Experiments show relative OOV character-error-rate reductions of up to 14.97% on LibriSpeech and 6.67% on dysarthric Speech Accessibility Project data for recurring OOV words, relative to the corresponding rescoring system.
title: Learning New Words from Unlabeled Test Data in Automatic Speech Recognition
title_translated: 从无标签测试数据中学习新词的自动语音识别方法
summary_translated: 新词每天都在被创造。人类听众只需清晰听到一次新词并根据句子上下文推断其用法即可学会。本文提出赋予ASR系统类似能力，使其能够在测试时从无标签测试数据中学习新词的上下文表征和拼写。一个冻结的CTC声学模型提供拼写信息，一个冻结的语言模型为词汇外（OOV）词检测提供上下文证据，而一个适配模块通过学习CTC生成候选词分布下的词汇标记表征来扩展词汇量。每个标记的拼写模型通过最小化Kullback-Leibler散度（KLD）目标进行优化。我们证明，CTC加权语言模型对数似然比可解释为未知正确ASR与无监督学习ASR之间的KLD，且利用Pinsker不等式，KLD的平方根可解释为未知词真实与估计拼写之间总变差距离的上界。实验表明，在LibriSpeech和发音障碍语音可访问性项目数据集上，对于重复出现的OOV词，相对OOV字符错误率分别降低了最多14.97%和6.67%，相比对应的重评分系统。

summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) corrects a student on the responses it writes, but its signal is the teacher's next-token distribution: it tells the student what the teacher says but misses how it thinks. Latent supervision promises the missing part by aligning the student's latent states to the teacher's. Recent methods such as OPRD bring this signal into on-policy distillation. However, we observe two failures of this recipe when distilling Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B into Qwen3-1.7B-Base. Early gain, late collapse: latent supervision alone lifts MATH-500 accuracy from 25 to 46 in 10 steps, but subsequent training degrades performance down to 11 with no recovery. Better alignment, worse behavior: although the alignment metric steadily improves throughout this collapse, the most aligned model turns out to be the worst performing. Further analysis suggests a mismatch in how the latent signal is applied: layers paired by depth play different roles in the two models, so continued alignment may pull the student toward teacher states it cannot understand. To address this, we propose LastOPD, which applies the latent signal only at the last-layer state, the common interface both LM heads read, and only during a 10-step crossfade into token-level OPD. This keeps the useful part of the latent signal and hands the student to token-level supervision before the collapse sets in. Extensive experiments show that LastOPD improves MATH-500 over token-only OPD by 5.55 and 4.02 points with the 4B and 8B teachers, leads on most held-out datasets, and reaches the final score of token-only OPD in about half the steps. Code is available at https://github.com/Muyiiiii/LastOPD.
title: LastOPD: Taming Collapse in Latent On-Policy Distillation
title_translated: LastOPD：驯服潜在在线策略蒸馏中的崩溃问题
summary_translated: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过教师的下一个词分布纠正学生模型的输出，但该信号仅反映教师说了什么，而忽略了其思考过程。潜在监督通过对齐学生与教师的潜在状态来弥补这一缺失。近期方法如OPRD将此信号引入在线策略蒸馏。然而，我们在将Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B蒸馏到Qwen3-1.7B-Base时观察到两种失败：早期提升，后期崩溃——仅使用潜在监督时，MATH-500准确率在10步内从25提升至46，但后续训练导致性能下降至11且无法恢复；更好的对齐，更差的行为——尽管对齐指标持续改善，最对齐的模型却是表现最差的。进一步分析表明，潜在信号应用存在不匹配：深度对应层在两个模型中扮演不同角色，持续对齐可能将学生拉向其无法理解的教师状态。为此，我们提出LastOPD，仅在最后一层状态施加潜在信号（即两个语言模型头共同读取的接口），且仅在10步跨fade进入词级OPD期间生效。这保留了潜在信号的有效部分，并在崩溃发生前将学生交由词级监督。大量实验表明，与仅词级OPD相比，LastOPD在4B和8B教师下分别提升MATH-500准确率5.55和4.02分，在多数保留数据集上领先，并在约一半步骤内达到词级OPD的最终得分。代码已公开于https://github.com/Muyiiiii/LastOPD。

summary: Audio-language models (ALMs) can exploit textual shortcuts to answer questions while overlooking acoustic evidence, weakening audio understanding. On-policy distillation (OPD) trains compact ALMs by supervising student-generated responses with teacher predictions, but does not explicitly distinguish acoustic support from linguistic predictability. We propose Reward-Tilted On-Policy Distillation (RT-OPD) to strengthen acoustic grounding. Given the same question and student-generated text, a frozen teacher predicts the next token with and without audio inputs. Their log-probability contrast defines a reward that reshapes the teacher distribution for reverse-KL distillation, emphasizing the additional evidence provided by audio. Across two compact students and three benchmarks, RT-OPD consistently outperforms Vanilla OPD. Experiments with silenced and replacement audio further suggest that RT-OPD strengthens the student's reliance on acoustic evidence. Our 3B model achieves 72.72% accuracy on MMAU, the highest among the compared 3B models and competitive with several 7B and 8B models. Code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/KaiyangLi1992/RT-OPD.
title: Reward-Tilted On-Policy Distillation for Acoustic Grounding in Audio-Language Models
title_translated: 用于音频-语言模型中声学定位的奖励倾斜在线策略蒸馏
summary_translated: 音频-语言模型（ALMs）可能利用文本捷径回答问题，而忽略声学证据，从而削弱音频理解能力。在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过教师预测监督学生生成的回答来训练紧凑型ALMs，但并未显式区分声学支持与语言可预测性。我们提出奖励倾斜在线策略蒸馏（RT-OPD）以增强声学定位。给定相同的问题和学生生成的文本，冻结的教师模型在有无音频输入的情况下分别预测下一个词。其对数概率差异定义了一个奖励信号，用于重塑教师分布以进行反向KL蒸馏，强调音频提供的额外证据。在两个紧凑型学生和三个基准测试中，RT-OPD始终优于原始OPD。对静音和替换音频的实验进一步表明，RT-OPD增强了学生对声学证据的依赖。我们的3B模型在MMAU上达到72.72%的准确率，是所比较3B模型中的最高水平，并与多个7B和8B模型具有竞争力。代码和模型检查点可在https://github.com/KaiyangLi1992/RT-OPD获取。

summary: We describe our submission to the Unsupervised Speech in the Wild (UPS) Challenge at Interspeech 2026, a bidirectional Mamba-2 (BiMamba2) encoder trained with masked discrete-unit prediction following the HuBERT-style paradigm. The 47.88M-parameter model is trained on 250 hours of speech across 67 languages from the MLCommons Unsupervised People's Speech dataset, with no labeled data. The objective combines masked k-means pseudo-label prediction with language identification supervision and VICReg regularization. On official evaluation, the system achieves an Adjusted Rand Index of 0.735, exceeding four baselines on speaker clustering. Language identification macro-F1 (0.073) and character error rate (0.870) remain below supervised baselines. We analyze a local-official discrepancy in metric scale and checkpoint ranking, highlighting limitations of in-distribution diagnostics for predicting Dynabench probe outcomes.
title: BiMamba2 Masked Discrete-Unit Prediction for Multilingual Speech Representation for Unsupervised Speech in the Wild Challenge
title_translated: BiMamba2掩码离散单元预测用于多语言语音表示：在无监督语音野外挑战中的提交
summary_translated: 我们介绍了在Interspeech 2026举办的无监督语音野外（UPS）挑战中的提交方案，采用双向Mamba-2（BiMamba2）编码器，遵循HuBERT风格范式，通过掩码离散单元预测进行训练。该模型包含4788万参数，基于MLCommons无监督人民语音数据集中的67种语言共250小时语音进行训练，全程无标签数据。目标函数结合了掩码k-means伪标签预测、语言识别监督和VICReg正则化。在官方评估中，系统在说话人聚类任务上取得0.735的调整兰德指数，超过四个基线模型。语言识别宏F1（0.073）和字符错误率（0.870）仍低于监督基线。我们分析了局部评估与官方评估在指标尺度和检查点排名上的差异，突显了分布内诊断在预测Dynabench探测结果方面的局限性。

summary: An estimated 1 billion people worldwide live with vision impairment, yet current vision-language models (VLMs) produce descriptions too vague for safe navigation by blind and low-vision (BLV) users. Large VLMs can generate high-quality audio-description-compliant narrations but cannot run on mobile devices; small VLMs offer competitive latency but lack spatial detail, directional cues, and hazard awareness for navigational assistance. We present Smol-VL-BLV, a compact VLM for blind and low-vision users that closes this gap using a 500M decoder transformer model and two post-training mechanisms: (1) teacher-student distillation and (2) Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a composite BLV reward targeting directional language, metric distances, and hazard detection. Because multi-stage post-training can induce catastrophic forgetting, we add a lightweight finetuning stage after the last stage GRPO finetuning to recover general descriptive quality while preserving BLV-specific spatial grounding. Our best model substantially outperforms the baseline across various benchmarks, including tasks: VQA, BLV captioning, OCR, and latency. Compared with the baseline for relative improvement, it improves the Spatial score gain of 19.3%, and the Social score gain of 14.8%. It also increases OCR-Bench by 101.5%, and raises TextVQA accuracy by 44.2%. These results show that BLV-focused post-training improves both accessibility-specific spatial grounding and general visual-text reasoning. Deployed on a mid-range Android smartphone via Mixed-Precision Quantization, the model remains approx. 450 MB and runs entirely on-device, offline and without network dependency, generating descriptions with latency dependent on host hardware capabilities. Our model, dataset, and code is publicly released at https://smol-vl-blv.github.io/Smol-VL-BLV-website/
title: Small yet Assistive: Spatially-Aware Post-Training for Low Vision
title_translated: 小巧却助人：面向低视力用户的时空感知后训练
summary_translated: 全球约有10亿人患有视力障碍，而当前的视觉-语言模型（VLM）生成的描述过于模糊，无法满足盲人和低视力（BLV）用户的安全导航需求。大型VLM虽然能生成高质量且符合音频描述要求的叙述，但无法在移动设备上运行；小型VLM虽具备良好的延迟表现，但在导航辅助中缺乏空间细节、方向提示和危险感知能力。我们提出了Smol-VL-BLV，一种专为盲人和低视力用户设计的紧凑型VLM，采用5亿参数的解码器Transformer模型，并结合两种后训练机制：(1) 教师-学生知识蒸馏；(2) 基于复合BLV奖励的组相对策略优化（GRPO），该奖励聚焦于方向性语言、度量距离和危险检测。由于多阶段后训练可能导致灾难性遗忘，我们在最后一次GRPO微调后加入轻量级微调阶段，以恢复通用描述质量，同时保留BLV特定的空间语义。我们的最优模型在多个基准测试中显著优于基线，涵盖任务如VQA、BLV图像字幕生成、OCR和延迟性能。相较于基线，其空间得分提升19.3%，社交得分提升14.8%；OCR-Bench得分提高101.5%，TextVQA准确率提升44.2%。结果表明，针对BLV的后训练能同时提升可访问性相关的空间语义与通用视觉-文本推理能力。通过混合精度量化部署在中端Android手机上，模型大小约为450MB，完全本地运行，离线且无需网络依赖，生成描述的延迟取决于主机硬件性能。我们的模型、数据集和代码已公开发布于https://smol-vl-blv.github.io/Smol-VL-BLV-website/

summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) countermeasures (CMs) have shown strong performance in recent years. However, they often show degraded performance while facing unseen spoofing attacks and mismatched conditions. This study examines the Voxtral audio-language model (ALM) framework for spoofing detection, as a step toward combining CM capabilities within the ALM framework. We analyze how Voxtral captures spoofing cues through audio-text processing and propose an instruction-guided approach that uses label-sequence likelihoods to evaluate bonafide and spoofed speech. Experiments on the ASVspoof databases show that without task-specific adaptation, the LLM layers emphasize semantic representations, reducing the separability of spoof-discriminative acoustic cues compared to the Whisper-based audio encoder. Consequently, spoofing-related information becomes less separable after language-model processing. We also applied lightweight adaptation using weight-decomposed low-rank adaptation (DoRA) to the Voxtral model and propose the Spooftral model, achieving an equal error rate (EER) of 4.25% on the ASVspoof5 evaluation set.
title: Spooftral: Can Voxtral Audio-Language Model Detect Speech Spoofing?
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to the Spoken Language Technology (SLT) 2026
title_translated: Spooftral：Voxtral语音-语言模型能否检测语音伪造？
summary_translated: 自监督学习（SSL）反制方法近年来表现出色，但在面对未见过的伪造攻击和不匹配条件时，性能常出现下降。本研究探讨了Voxtral语音-语言模型（ALM）框架在语音伪造检测中的应用，旨在将反制能力整合进ALM框架。我们分析了Voxtral如何通过音视频处理捕捉伪造线索，并提出一种基于指令引导的方法，利用标签序列似然来评估真实与伪造语音。在ASVspoof数据库上的实验表明，未经任务特定适配时，LLM层更强调语义表示，导致伪造判别性声学特征的可分性降低，相比基于Whisper的音频编码器。因此，语言模型处理后，与伪造相关的信息变得难以区分。我们还对Voxtral模型应用了轻量级适配方法——权重分解低秩适配（DoRA），并提出了Spooftral模型，在ASVspoof5评估集上实现了4.25%的等错误率（EER）。

summary: Retrieval-augmented question answering requires control decisions about when to decompose a question, search, reformulate, extract evidence, synthesize facts, verify progress, and stop. We study whether trajectory fine-tuning can improve small language models (SLMs) as next-action controllers. We additionally evaluate a low-resource setting in which a single SLM serves as both the controller and the final-answer generator. From accepted teacher search traces, we build a seven-way action-prediction task, where the model predicts the next structured teacher action from the current trajectory state, and evaluate LoRA-supervised fine-tuning across SLMs and xSLMs as controllers. On 1,646 held-out action examples, Granite 4.1 3B trained on 13,194 actions reaches macro-F1 0.6536, compared with 0.1736 for zero-shot prompting of the same model and 0.5399 for a TF-IDF logistic-regression baseline. In an end-to-end controller/generator swap evaluation over 149 held-out trajectories, using the fine-tuned model for both roles improves Exact Match from 0.7530 to 0.7946 and token F1 from 0.7783 to 0.8295 compared with using the base model as both controller and generator. The cross-role conditions show that the fine-tuned controller increases evidence-fact recording when the generator is fixed, while controller-only final-answer gains are not statistically clear. Overall, trajectory supervision improves action prediction and evidence-recording behaviour in this evaluated pipeline. Code is available at https://github.com/padas-lab-de/agent-action-controller
title: The Fellowship of the Query: Learning Retrieval Actions
title_translated: 查询的盟友：学习检索动作
summary_translated: 检索增强型问答需要在何时分解问题、搜索、重述、提取证据、合成事实、验证进展和停止等操作上做出控制决策。我们研究了轨迹微调是否能提升小型语言模型（SLMs）作为下一步动作控制器的能力。此外，我们还评估了一种低资源场景，即单一SLM同时担任控制器和最终答案生成器。基于被接受的教师搜索轨迹，我们构建了一个七类动作预测任务，模型需根据当前轨迹状态预测下一个结构化教师动作，并在SLMs和xSLMs上评估LoRA监督微调的表现。在1,646个保留的动作样本上，Granite 4.1 3B模型在13,194个动作上训练后达到宏F1值0.6536，远高于相同模型零样本提示的0.1736和TF-IDF逻辑回归基线的0.5399。在149个保留轨迹的端到端控制器/生成器互换评估中，使用微调后的模型担任两个角色，使精确匹配从0.7530提升至0.7946，token F1从0.7783提升至0.8295，相较使用基础模型担任双角色有明显改进。跨角色条件显示，微调后的控制器在固定生成器时提升了证据事实记录，而仅控制器的最终答案提升无统计显著性。总体而言，轨迹监督改善了该流程中的动作预测与证据记录行为。代码已公开于https://github.com/padas-lab-de/agent-action-controller

summary: Post hoc explanation methods such as SHAP and LIME are widely used to interpret text classifiers, but their visualizations are mainly designed for left-to-right languages. When applied to right-to-left (RTL) languages such as Urdu, Arabic, Persian, and Hebrew, the attribution values remain mathematically valid, while their visual presentation fails. Tokens appear out of sequence, connected letterforms break apart, and plot layouts do not follow the natural reading direction. This study addresses this gap as a visualization problem rather than a limitation of the explanation methods themselves. We present SHAP-RTL, a rendering layer that corrects reading direction and script shaping in SHAP and LIME visualizations, with per-language font selection, while preserving the original attribution values, feature ordering, and model outputs. The approach is evaluated on Urdu, Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian hate and offensive-language datasets using TF-IDF and logistic regression classifiers. Rendering correctness is measured by an OCR round trip over 200 feature words per language. Default rendering yields character error rates of 0.820 to 0.979, meaning the label no longer carries its token; the common reshape-and-reorder workaround fails for Urdu at 0.998, worse than no correction; and the Matplotlib 3.11.0 text rewrite inverts that workaround, while SHAP-RTL remains correct under both versions. The framework also verbalizes the same attributions as short contextual explanations in the reader's language, constrained to the identified features. Evaluation in this paper concerns rendering correctness; assessment of the generated explanations is left to future work. The study highlights the importance of language-aware visualization in making post hoc explainability more accessible across different writing systems.
title: When Explanations Cannot Be Read: Measuring and Correcting SHAP and LIME Rendering for Right-to-Left Languages
title_translated: 当解释无法阅读时：测量并修正SHAP与LIME在右至左语言中的渲染问题
summary_translated: 事后解释方法如SHAP和LIME广泛用于解释文本分类器，但其可视化主要针对左至右语言设计。当应用于阿拉伯语、乌尔都语、波斯语和希伯来语等右至左（RTL）语言时，尽管归因值在数学上仍有效，其视觉呈现却失效：词元顺序错乱，连写字符断裂，图表布局不符合自然阅读方向。本研究将此问题视为可视化缺陷而非解释方法本身的局限。我们提出了SHAP-RTL，一个渲染层，可在保留原始归因值、特征排序和模型输出的前提下，修正SHAP和LIME可视化中的阅读方向与脚本形态，支持按语言选择字体。该方法在乌尔都语、阿拉伯语、希伯来语和波斯语的仇恨与冒犯性语言数据集上，使用TF-IDF和逻辑回归分类器进行了评估。通过每语言200个特征词的OCR往返测试衡量渲染正确性。默认渲染的字符错误率达0.820至0.979，意味着标签不再对应其词元；常见的重新排列修复方法在乌尔都语上失败，错误率达0.998，甚至劣于无修正；Matplotlib 3.11.0的文本重写反而逆转了该修复效果；而SHAP-RTL在两个版本下均保持正确。该框架还能将相同归因转化为读者语言的简短上下文解释，仅限于识别出的特征。本文评估聚焦于渲染正确性；生成解释的有效性留待未来工作。研究强调了语言感知可视化在提升不同书写系统下事后可解释性可及性方面的重要性。

summary: Conversational AI increasingly mediates intimate-partner communication, and refusal logic at the inference layer now functions as a governance threshold for gendered harm. This article asks whether such systems reproduce discursive forms historically tied to the privatization of intimate violence. A three-stage audit of six widely accessible conversational AI systems compares refusal behaviour across 1,600 crossed prompts per system, isolates relational framing through 300 matched prompt pairs, and contrasts pre-submission framing with post-output critique across fresh sessions. Four systems refused fewer than 1% of prompts. ChatGPT 5.2 and Claude Sonnet 4.5 refused most requests, but residual leakage clustered under intimate framing. Switching from a non-intimate to an intimate-partner descriptor amplified non-refusal 4.4-fold and 10.8-fold. Post-output critique produced in-session acknowledgement that did not carry across fresh sessions, with 96-100% of leaked prompts re-leaking. The article names this pattern the Domestic Unprotected Zone, a privatization-like threshold at the inference layer.
title: The Domestic Unprotected Zone: Algorithmic Governance and the Reproduction of Perpetrator Discourse in Conversational AI
comment: 59 pages, 8 figures, 27 tables. Supplementary material (S1-S4) included as an appendix. Preprint; under review
title_translated: 家庭无保护区：对话式AI中的算法治理与施害者话语的再生产
summary_translated: 对话式AI日益介入亲密伴侣间的沟通，推理层的拒绝逻辑现已成为性别伤害的治理阈值。本文探讨此类系统是否再现了历史上与亲密暴力私有化相关的言辞形式。对六款广泛可访问的对话式AI系统进行三阶段审计，比较每系统1,600个交叉提示下的拒绝行为，通过300对匹配提示对隔离关系框架，并对比新会话中提交前的框架与输出后的批判之间的差异。四个系统拒绝提示的比例低于1%。ChatGPT 5.2和Claude Sonnet 4.5拒绝请求最多，但残留泄漏集中在亲密关系框架下。从非亲密描述切换为亲密伴侣描述，非拒绝率分别放大4.4倍和10.8倍。输出后的批判在会话内产生承认，但无法延续至新会话，96%-100%的泄漏提示再次泄漏。本文将这一模式命名为“家庭无保护区”，即推理层存在的类似私有化的阈值。

summary: Forecasting agents increasingly combine language-model reasoning, retrieval, ensembling, and calibration, but it remains unclear when each behavior should be trusted. We study this question on ForecastBench-style binary forecasting tasks, treating the choice to retrieve, reason, defer to a market prior, or use a historical analog as an observable agent behavior rather than a hidden implementation detail. Our central finding is that mechanism choice is source-dependent: structured analogs dominate for some data-generating processes, while market/crowd-style and conservative baselines are better for others. We introduce ReliabilityRoute, a structural intervention that steers forecasting-agent behavior using reliability features such as historical coverage, market-prior availability, source-prior sharpness, evidence strength, evidence disagreement, and horizon. A fixed 2024-fitted rule closely matches a hand taxonomy without hard-coded source-name decisions, while a walk-forward self-adjusting rule refits thresholds from previously resolved vintages and obtains the best mean Brier score among our deterministic systems across 16 later LLM vintages. The gain is modest and historical/search baselines remain highly competitive. The main contribution is therefore a behavioral stress test showing that more reasoning is not always better; forecasting agents should first estimate which evidence source deserves control, routing policies should themselves adapt under auditable constraints, and reproducibility artifacts are available at https://github.com/louiswang524/forcastagent
title: When Should Forecasting Agents Reason? Behavioral Stress Tests for Reliability Routing
title_translated: 预测智能体何时应进行推理？可靠性路由的行为压力测试
summary_translated: 预测智能体越来越多地结合语言模型推理、检索、集成和校准，但目前尚不清楚在何种情况下应信任每种行为。我们在类似ForecastBench的二元预测任务上研究这一问题，将选择检索、推理、依赖市场先验或使用历史类比视为可观测的智能体行为，而非隐藏的实现细节。核心发现是机制选择具有来源依赖性：某些数据生成过程下结构化类比占优，而其他情况下市场/群体风格及保守基线表现更佳。我们提出ReliabilityRoute，一种结构化干预方法，通过历史覆盖度、市场先验可用性、源先验锐度、证据强度、证据分歧度和时间跨度等可靠性特征来引导预测智能体的行为。一个固定于2024年拟合的规则在无需硬编码源名称决策的情况下，紧密匹配人工分类体系；而一个向前滚动自调整规则则基于先前已解决版本重新拟合阈值，在后续16个LLM版本中取得了所有确定性系统中的最佳平均Brier得分。尽管提升有限，历史/搜索基线仍保持高度竞争力。主要贡献在于提出了一种行为压力测试，表明更多推理并不总是更好；预测智能体应首先评估哪个证据来源值得控制，路由策略自身应在可审计约束下适应变化，可复现性结果见https://github.com/louiswang524/forcastagent。
